recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. If the DataAbsentReason code ever disappears from the rendered ValueSet, the follow-up should be a THO terminology correction rather than a FHIR-core source edit.
issue_request: FHIR-13521 is a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core STU3 OO change request to add a declined reason to the Data Absent Reason value set, with the final resolution renaming asked to asked-unknown, adding asked-declined, renaming temp to temp-unknown, and placing asked-unknown, asked-declined, temp-unknown, and not-asked under unknown.
initial_application: Historical commit e7d78b64cb2a41fcce79fa37fdad6ce089167b12 applied GF#13521 by adding asked-declined and the requested Data Absent Reason code renames/hierarchy in source/terminologies/bindings.xml, while d06b52856c89401a981241a811faa7b455037c08 performed follow-up display/name cleanup.
additional_context: FHIR core now keeps the DataAbsentReason ValueSet as a build-scoped value set that includes all codes from the external THO CodeSystem http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/data-absent-reason. Recursive inspection of THO 7.1.0 CodeSystem-data-absent-reason.json shows 15 concepts, including asked-unknown, temp-unknown, not-asked, and asked-declined under unknown. FHIR-15567 is the companion DAR cleanup and is already represented on the combined branch; FHIR-39238 later reused asked-declined for Gender Harmony.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Reintroducing local core CodeSystem content or duplicating concepts in the ValueSet would conflict with the current terminology ownership model because the authoritative DataAbsentReason code content lives in THO and already contains the requested concepts.

related_jiras.note: Companion Published OO issue for Data Absent Reason code, definition, hierarchy, and Observation value set cleanup; already represented on the combined branch.
Later Published Gender Harmony request that uses asked-declined from the DataAbsentReason code system, confirming the code exists as reusable terminology.
